48100.meaning1: very close; extremely near (to); nearly upon
48100.commentary: (SNa) bahuāgato kho my'āyan'ti mayhaṃ atthāya ayaṃ bahutaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgato, appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, idāni maṃ gaṇhissatī'ti ñatvā dāruguḷo viya vinivattitvā tass'eva leḍḍussa antare paccupādi, paṭipanno paviṭṭho'ti attho.

examples.text: yadā kho, bhikkhave, aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahuāgato kho my'āyaṃ sakuṇagghī'ti, atha tass'eva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi. atha kho, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi tatth'eva uraṃ paccatāḷesi.

48101.meaning1: with many disadvantages; with lots of drawbacks

examples.text: katamā c'ānanda, ādīnavasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, bahudukkho kho ayaṃ kāyo bahuādīnavo.
dānañ'ca yuddhañ'ca samānam'āhu, app'āpi santā bahuke jinanti, appam'pi ce saddahāno dadāti, ten'eva so hoti sukhī paratthā'ti.
acchindāpeyyā'ti aññaṃ āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. sakiṃ āṇatto bahukam'pi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
dhi'r'atthu kāmā asucī, duggandhā bahukaṇṭakā, yattha mātā ca dhītā ca, sabhariyā mayaṃ ahuṃ.

48104.commentary: (MNa) bahukataṃ hotī'ti ettāvatā'pi bahuṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti

examples.text: tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato, evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato, evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.

48105.meaning1: busy; with lots to do; with many duties
48105.notes: (MW) one who has (or complains of having) much to do, who never has time for anything

examples.text: handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bho gotama, gacchāma. bahukiccā mayaṃ, bahukaraṇīyā'ti. yassa'dāni tvaṃ, aggivessana, kālaṃ maññasī'ti.
mayaṃ kho, mārisa moggallāna, bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā, app'eva sakena karaṇīyena, api ca devānaṃ'y'eva tāvatiṃsānaṃ karaṇīyena.

48106.meaning1: very useful; extremely helpful; of great service (for or in)

examples.text: yoniso manasikāro, dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno, n'atth'añño evaṃ bahukāro, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, yoniso padahaṃ bhikkhu, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe'ti.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇā bahukārā hoti kusalesu dhammesu

48110.meaning1: busy; with lots to do; with many duties

examples.text: handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bho gotama, gacchāma. bahukiccā mayaṃ, bahukaraṇīyā'ti. yassa'dāni tvaṃ, aggivessana, kālaṃ maññasī'ti.
mayaṃ kho, mārisa moggallāna, bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā, app'eva sakena karaṇīyena, api ca devānaṃ'y'eva tāvatiṃsānaṃ karaṇīyena.
tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca pabbajitā ca, asuciṃ garahitaṃ dhunanti pāpaṃ, sa hi sucibhi parivuto bhavati, mala-khila-kali-kilese panudehī'ti.

48113.meaning1: multitude; many people; mass of people

examples.text: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa… te upasaṅkamitvā te pañhe pucchati.
yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

48114.grammar: nt, comp, dat sg of bahujanāsukha
48114.meaning1: for the discomfort of many people

examples.text: yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. yo hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujana-asukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48115.grammar: nt, comp, dat sg of bahujanāhita
48115.meaning1: for the disadvantage of many people; for the harm of the people
48115.commentary: (VINa) bahujana-ahitāya paṭipanno hotī'ti vinayadharena hi evaṃ chand'ādigatiyā adhikaraṇe vinicchite tasmiṃ vihāre saṅgho dvidhā bhijjati. ovād'ūpajīviniyo bhikkhuniyo'pi dve bhāgā honti. upāsakā'pi upāsikāyo'pi dārakā'pi dārikāyo'pi tesaṃ ārakkhadevatā'pi tath'eva dvidhā bhijjanti. tato bhummadevatā ādiṃ katvā yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmāno dvidhāva honti. tena vuttaṃ, bahujana-ahitāya paṭipanno hoti… dukkhāya devamanussānan'ti.

examples.text: yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. yo hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujana-asukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48116.meaning1: pleasing to the people; loved by the people
48116.commentary: (MNa) nagaravāsino hi yuttakathā honti, pitimattaṃ pitā'ti, bhātimattaṃ bhātā'ti vadanti. evarūpī kathā bahuno janassa kantā hotī'ti bahujanakantā

examples.text: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ, yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.

48117.grammar: nt, abstr, comp, dat sg of bahujanadukkha
48117.meaning1: for the discomfort of many people; for the suffering of the masses

examples.text: tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ñāto bhikkhu bahujana-ahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanadukkhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ. katamehi tīhi?

48118.meaning1: with a large retinue (of); surrounded by numerous

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? thero hoti rattaññū cirapabbajito, ñāto hoti yasassī gahaṭṭhapabbajitānaṃ bahujanaparivāro, lābhī hoti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ

48119.meaning1: eminent among the people; leading the multitude (in)

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno bahujanapubbaṅ'gamo ahosi kusalesu dhammesu bahujanapāmokkho kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse… aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

48120.meaning1: loved by the multitude; held dear by the people

examples.text: piyadassano gihī'pi santo ca, bhavati bahujanapiyāyito, yadi ca na bhavati gihī samaṇo hoti, piyo bahūnaṃ sokanāsanoti.

48121.meaning1: leading the people; forerunner of the multitude (in)
48121.commentary: (DNa) bahujanapubbaṅ'gamo ahosī'ti bahujanassa pubbaṅ'gamo ahosi gaṇajeṭṭhako. tassa diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ aññe āpajjiṃsu.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno bahujanapubbaṅ'gamo ahosi kusalesu dhammesu bahujanapāmokkho kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite… aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

48122.meaning1: insulting the people; disrespecting the population
48122.commentary: (DNa) bahujanappamaddanan'ti bahujanānaṃ pamaddaniṃ (DNt) bahuno janassa avamaddanato, pamaddābhāvakaraṇato vā bahujanappamaddanaṃ.

examples.text: akkosabhaṇḍanavihesakāriṃ, ubbādhikaṃ bahujanappamaddanaṃ, abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusaṃ, madhuraṃ bhaṇi susaṃhitaṃ sakhilaṃ.

48123.meaning1: charming to the people; pleasing to the masses

examples.text: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ, yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.

48124.meaning1: comfort of many people; ease of the masses

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48125.grammar: nt, abstr, comp, dat sg of bahujanasukha
48125.meaning1: for the comfort of many people; for the ease of the masses
48125.meaning2: for the happiness of many people, for the ease of multitude

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48127.grammar: nt, comp, dat sg of bahujanahita
48127.meaning1: for the benefit of many people; for the good of the population

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

48128.grammar: nt, abstr, comp, dat sg of bahujanāsukha, neg
48128.meaning1: for the discomfort of many people

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujan'āhitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48129.grammar: nt, comp, dat sg of bahujanāhita, neg
48129.meaning1: for the disadvantage of many people; for the harm of the people

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujan'āhitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
appamatto pamattesu, suttesu bahujāgaro, abal'assaṃ'va sīgh'asso, hitvā yāti sumedhaso.
okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.

48131.meaning1: multitude; many people; mass of people

examples.text: ahaṃ nāgo'va saṅgāme, cāpato patitaṃ saraṃ, ativākyaṃ titikkhissaṃ, dussīlo hi bahujjano.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yo v'āyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī'ti?
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.

48135.meaning1: with numerous females; with many women

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bahudantī ca piṅgayo, te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.

48137.commentary: (SNa) bahudukkhā'ti pañca kāmaguṇe nissāya pattabbadukkhassa bahutāya bahudukkhā. (MNa) bahudukkhā'ti diṭṭhadhammika-samparāyika-dukkham'ev'ettha bahukaṃ.

examples.text: app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
kālikā hi, āvuso, kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti.

48138.meaning1: so much; so big; much of

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'āṇu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi. āyasmā'pi kho soṇo bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.

48139.meaning1: most of the night; much of the evening
48139.construction:
bahu + [d] + eva + ratti + iṃ
bahudevaratti + iṃ

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'evarattiṃ abbhokāse caṅkamitvā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.

48140.meaning1: with many gateways; with many entrances

48142.meaning1: in many ways; in many forms

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ
ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.

48143.meaning1: with many states; with lots of elements

48144.commentary: (MNa) ānanda, yasmā imasmiṃ dhammapariyāye aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cha imā, ānanda, dhātuyo'ti evaṃ bahudhātuyo vibhattā, tasmā tiha tvaṃ imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ bahudhātuko'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi.

examples.text: konāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ bahudhātuko'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, catuparivaṭṭo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammādāso'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, amatadundubhī'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.

48148.commentary: (VINa) tassā kira dasa puttā dasa dhītaro ahesuṃ, bahū nattāro assā'ti bahunattā.

48149.grammar: adj, masc & nt instr sg of bahu
48149.meaning1: by many; with lots; by much

examples.text: satto guhāyaṃ bahunā-abhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.
bahunā'pi kho taṃ vibhajeyyaṃ, pariyāyena tādiso dhammo, saṃkhittam'atthaṃ lapayissāmi, yāvatā me manasā pariyattaṃ.

48150.meaning1: well underway; on the road for a long time

examples.text: yadā aññāsi dutiyo satthavāho, bahunikkhanto kho, bho, dāni so sattho'ti bahuṃ tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca udakañ'ca āropetvā satthaṃ payāpesi.

48152.commentary: (SNa) bahun'eke na dicchare'ti bahunā'pi bhogena samannāgatā ekacce na dadanti.

examples.text: appasm'eke pavecchanti, bahun'eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti.

48153.meaning1: with many goods; having lots of possessions

examples.text: app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
kālikā hi, āvuso, kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti.

48155.commentary: (ANt) bahuputtakan'ti ca bahupāroho eko nigrodharukkho, tasmiṃ adhivatthaṃ devataṃ bahū manussā putte patthenti, tadupādāya taṃ ṭhānaṃ bahuputtakaṃ cetiyan'ti paññāyittha.

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, ramaṇīyā, ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ satt'ambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sāran'dadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.

48156.commentary: (VINa) bahū dhītaro ca puttā ca assā'ti bahuputtā.

48157.commentary: (ANt) bahuputtakan'ti ca bahupāroho eko nigrodharukkho, tasmiṃ adhivatthaṃ devataṃ bahū manussā putte patthenti, tadupādāya taṃ ṭhānaṃ bahuputtakaṃ cetiyan'ti paññāyittha.

examples.text: puratthimena vesāliṃ udenaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ, taṃ n'ātikkameyyaṃ, dakkhiṇena vesāliṃ gotamakaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ, taṃ n'ātikkameyyaṃ, pacchimena vesāliṃ satt'ambaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ, taṃ n'ātikkameyyaṃ, uttarena vesāliṃ bahuputtakaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ n'ātikkameyyan'ti.

48158.commentary: (ANt) bahuputtakan'ti ca bahupāroho eko nigrodharukkho, tasmiṃ adhivatthaṃ devataṃ bahū manussā putte patthenti, tadupādāya taṃ ṭhānaṃ bahuputtakaṃ cetiyan'ti paññāyittha.

examples.text: ramaṇīyā, ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ satt'ambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ ānandacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.

48160.meaning2: many kinds; many sorts; lots of types

examples.text: yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā n'evasaññin'āsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
apādakehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ dvipādakehi me, catuppadehi me mettaṃ, mettaṃ bahuppadehi me.

yāvatā, cundi, sattā apādā vā dvīpādā vācatuppādā vā bahuppādā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā n'evasaññin'āsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. ye kho, cundi, buddhe pasannā, agge te pasannā.
328, 352. aññapad'atthesu bahubbīhi.
aññesaṃ padānaṃ atthesu dve nāmāni bahūni nāmāni yadā samasyante, tadā so samāso bahubbīhi sañño hoti.

48165.meaning1: with many goods; having lots of possessions
